{"summary":"当前草稿为第十一章《未归的航标》修订版2，仅含林默走进北门的重复动作。已确认记忆显示：第6章21:05低室电台收到三次求救码；白色渡船未靠岸、来源未明；异常雾钟在北潮闸未关闭时响起，原因未解。","summary_sources":[{"source_type":"draft_claim","source_id":"draft-claim-draft-432b11b1-c704-4170-a352-446cb6064878-r2-1"},{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-34d22780-d49a-40b8-9e9c-5b5b136b1042"},{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-bb9e7ece-bd0b-498a-98d6-fb60d3e4040a"}],"items":[{"section":"recent_source","text":"当前草稿第十一章《未归的航标》修订版2的正文仅有两句相同内容：林默走进北门。","sources":[{"source_type":"draft_claim","source_id":"draft-claim-draft-432b11b1-c704-4170-a352-446cb6064878-r2-1"},{"source_type":"draft_claim","source_id":"draft-claim-draft-432b11b1-c704-4170-a352-446cb6064878-r2-2"}]},{"section":"confirmed_fact","text":"已确认事件时间线：第6章21:05，低室电台收到三次求救码。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-34d22780-d49a-40b8-9e9c-5b5b136b1042"}]},{"section":"confirmed_fact","text":"已确认事件时间线：第3章19:20为西航道退潮。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-7d875922-a0a2-4be1-8d2f-3ca8fb815a6d"}]},{"section":"confirmed_fact","text":"已确认静态设定：灰港雾钟只在北潮闸完全关闭后敲响一次。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-de68ba88-54dc-4080-a24a-81cd913fde20"}]},{"section":"character_state","text":"已确认动态状态：黄铜罗盘当前由温岚持有。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-aa6343e8-53f3-4600-b650-9ce1c31b1432"}]},{"section":"character_state","text":"已确认人物知识：温岚不知道廊桥钥匙的含义。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-9c5a6a0a-2069-4169-9f87-d8cb073942f1"}]},{"section":"world_rule","text":"已确认动态状态：航图位于雾线水门外锚柱。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-6cb41d9d-983c-4326-bb3f-1743e217b4ab"}]},{"section":"open_thread","text":"未解线索：白色渡船没有靠岸，来源未明。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-4d12166c-bccc-4728-a051-f7e0b7614087"}]},{"section":"open_thread","text":"未解线索：异常雾钟在北潮闸未关闭时响起，原因未解。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-bb9e7ece-bd0b-498a-98d6-fb60d3e4040a"}]},{"section":"recent_source","text":"第6章《低室电台》原文：电台在二十一点零五分收到三次短促求救码，信号来自雾线水门以外。","sources":[{"source_type":"source_span","source_id":"span-62ae7d78-95f9-41d5-8297-234791dd5ca7"}]},{"section":"recent_source","text":"第10章《回声坐标》原文：北潮闸并未关闭，雾钟却响了一次；温岚仍握着罗盘，港外传来白色渡船的汽笛。","sources":[{"source_type":"source_span","source_id":"span-77b2fe59-b0b0-498f-acfc-3115ae14df94"}]},{"section":"recent_source","text":"第9章《换手》原文：进入仓道前，苏岑把带月牙裂纹的黄铜罗盘交到温岚手里保管。","sources":[{"source_type":"source_span","source_id":"span-01df0d99-a5c7-4a55-883b-066c998b4f23"}]}]}
